digest.component_or_area: live multi-project rehearsal tests against ephemeral Jira DC instance
propositions: Non-existent project keys configured in the mapping cause real Jira to return parse errors rather than empty results, aborting the entire inbound pass when the fetcher lacks per-project exception handling.
A fake transport masks cross-project isolation failures and unknown-project error paths because it returns empty for unmapped projects instead of failing closed like real Jira.

The rehearsal must run against an ephemeral Jira DC instance with admin-provisionable throwaway projects to model all three repo configurations, empty-project scenarios, and unknown-key fail-closed behavior.
Every mutating scenario must be preview-gated and validated to contain only targets in its intended project with empty intersection against all other configured projects before bridge sync executes.
Scratch projects must be created with a hardened pinned template, have capabilities verified, and be deleted on all exit paths including mid-scenario failures to prevent cross-run contamination.
